title: pm-dispatch: 'security by consequence, not label' grants the xhigh diff review only to advisory fixes, so a private-repo security issue of the same severity gets none
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the #35270 review sweep (run records r09 S2, r10 S3) on PR #35591, re-read on main c30ce97cd7

## What happens
The dispatch rules say security work is graded "by consequence, not by label", but the next line grants the extra security review only to fixes of a public-repository security advisory. A vulnerability in a private repository is tracked as an ordinary issue with a `security` label, not an advisory, so a cross-tenant or privilege fix there gets no adversarial review at all — the same consequence, a lower bar, decided only by where the record is kept.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:130`: 「安全按后果不按标签:仅高危公告(跨租户或越权读写、提权、认证绕过)的修复得 `xhigh`」.
- `:131` the `xhigh` short adversarial diff review rides that 公告 arm only.
- `:132`: 「带 `security` 标签而非公告修复的卡(依赖、UX、文案)按难度定」 — the examples show the intent; the criterion covers every non-advisory security card.
- `references/security-findings.md:16-19` and `:29-30`: a public repo's finding is an advisory; a private repo's finding is a `security`-labelled issue handled by that repo's lane under these same rules. A mistakenly public card under takeover is also label-marked (`security-findings.md` §3/§9).

## Done when
- `:130-132` key on the finding's consequence whatever the carrier (advisory, private-repo `security` issue, taken-over card), and `:132` is scoped to `security`-labelled cards that fix no finding (deps, UX, copy).
- Pins: ratchet rows for the touched lines updated; skill gates pass.
- Ablation: a grep pin that `:132` names "fixes no finding" (or equivalent) fails if the scope clause is dropped.

reach: internal fleet skill text, read by every repo lane that fixes a security finding, including private repos.
Business reason: a serious security fix in a private repository can ship without the extra review the same fix gets in a public one.
Reader: area:fleet (pm-dispatch skill owner); copy the security seat.
Dedupe: `security advisory effort`, `xhigh`, `35591` → #35270 (open parent, does not carry this), #32004 (seat card).
Grade: p3 — rule text; the gap is review depth on a subset of security fixes.
